description: A real, small merged bug fix: interleave_evenly([]) raised IndexError instead of returning an empty result. seed/mod.py is the verbatim pre-fix interleave_evenly(), extracted to a standalone module. seed/test_mod.py is the real InterleaveEvenlyTests test class from that commit's tests/test_more.py (imports adapted, some smoke/randomized tests dropped for determinism), including the real regression test the PR added — the oracle this case is judged against.
note: generate/qa phases are skipped for this case — seed/ is copied in as-is and only `atomic-forge repair` runs. This case's ground-truth error (IndexError from an unguarded index into an empty list two statements after the actual bad condition) is a slightly harder localization target than the chunked_negative_n case's direct ValueError-vs-ValueError mismatch.
